# `atan`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the inverse tangent (a.k.a. arc tangent) of `expr`, as if computed by
`java.lang.Math.atan`

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
atan(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- atan, example 1
> SELECT atan(0);
0.0
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.4.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
